title: Monkeysphere Cutbacks
html:
Quest Giver: Sir Kent the Artisan

Quest Type: Hunt

Quest Description: Kill the following things enemies in Algernon

  • 25 Whisker Broodlings
  • 25 Whisker Blademasters

Quest Reward: 1250 Gold + 1 KC

Return to:Sir Kent the Artisan

Repeatable: No

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Kill 25 Whisker Broodlings and 25 Whisker Blademasters to reduce Sir Kent the Artisan's Monkeysphere. Afteward, return to Sir Kent the Artisan on Level 1 of Algernon.

Offer:

I like it here. No people. It is that simple. In fact, some of the creatures here in Algernon are down right pleasant in comparison to those goons in Townston. There is only one problem, there are just too many Whiskers Broodlings and Whisker Blademasters and my Monkeysphere is getting overpopulated. If there was a way to get rid of some of those Whiskers, I just might start interacting with them again.

Say, you think you could go and kill of some of those Whiskers here in Algernon for me? Just knock down their numbers a couple pegs and I could start having my afternoon tea parties again. When you are done return to me, Sir Kent the Artisan, here on the first level of Algernon, for your reward.

Turn-in:

I felt a great disturbance in Algernon, as if millions, okay, maybe a couple dozens, of voices suddenly screeched out in terror and were suddenly silenced. I fear something terribly wonderful has happened. I can start to feel myself caring again, thank you!

Objectives:

  • Slain Whiskers Broodlings
  • Slain Whiskers Blademasters

Client level range: 5–20
